components.name: Signal Chip
components.description: A hard-edged channel or live-state label.
components.css: .ds-signal-chip { display:inline-block; padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid #00F0FF; border-radius:3px; background:#100B1F; color:#00F0FF; font:700 12px/1.2 ui-monospace,monospace; letter-spacing:.12em; box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(0,240,255,.35); }

components.name: Neon Panel
components.description: A contained broadcast surface for a single signature visual.
components.css: .ds-neon-panel { padding:16px; border:1px solid #8B5CF6; border-radius:12px; background:#080611; color:#F4F1FF; box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(139,92,246,.28); font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-neon-panel strong { color:#D9FF3F; font-family:ui-monospace,monospace; letter-spacing:.12em; } .ds-neon-panel p { color:#B8ADD2; }

narrative.overview: The profile behaves like an intercepted builder broadcast: real coordinates, project callsigns, and living telemetry framed by punk-flyer energy, arcade diagnostics, PCB traces, and ultraviolet club lighting.
keyCharacteristics: Terminal labels with oversized display lettering
Factual project indexes as the backbone

rules.name: The Four-Signal Rule
rules.body: A composed asset uses at least two neon roles; acid yellow remains rare enough to mean live energy.

rules.name: The Native Body Rule
rules.body: Paragraphs remain in GitHub's native body type; terminal mono is for labels and telemetry.

rules.name: The Contained Glow Rule
rules.body: Every bloom effect lives inside an SVG boundary.

dos: Use large authored SVG moments at the opening and closing of the page.
Preserve real repository links and plain-language descriptions.
Provide a non-animated state for motion-sensitive visitors.
donts: Return to monochrome cyan or generic matrix-code styling.
Stack dozens of unrelated service cards and badges.
Simulate accomplishments, activity, or contribution data.
